title: Trial run: one OpenSpec change from setup to merge
what: In a fresh session (so the merge-2 hooks are loaded): `relay setup <scratch project> --flow openspec`, add `--relay-folder` so the hard rules apply, then one tiny OpenSpec change through propose, spec review, apply, apply review, checker, gate and `--ff-only` merge. Record each refusal or gap; fix relay where it breaks (its own change, reviewed). Afterwards remove the scratch project and its projects.toml entry.
why: The owner wants to start a new project with relay and OpenSpec (owner, 2026-10-23: "I want to start build new project with relay", then picked 1a: trial run first). Since merge 2 a merge needs a green gate log and a checker mark; nobody checked that the OpenSpec (sdd) flow's reviews lead to that mark, and no test runs an OpenSpec change to a merge.
failing_case: Today unknown: the merge hook (plugins/core/hooks/merge.py:159) refuses without a checker mark; the sdd review agents may never produce one, so the first OpenSpec merge in a new project would be refused with "no check mark".
pass_cases: The tiny change merges with the gate and the mark in place, or every gap found is queued or fixed before the owner's real project starts.
dropped_why: done: merged at 19c02df, findings queued (owner picked "a": close the finished trial with drop, since no command closes a feature)
